method: CPU-only dynamic import of the actual music-performance helper on a blank same-origin test page. Simplified Three Group/Object3D rig retains actual key layout, arm hierarchy and paw hierarchy. Three actual score sequences read from music.js; no scene/GPU render or video recording.

checks.name: 93 adjacent note boundaries keep robot and cat world position continuous
Both sides of every boundary release all keys before the next press
All 96 real notes preserve key contact throughout three pressed-phase samples
Both robot and cat retain actual contact assignments
No WebGL context or rendering was created

limits: This verifies root world-position and rotation continuity, pressed-phase effector contact and score assignment numerically. It does not certify rendered image interpolation or GPU timing.
The boundary epsilon is plus/minus one millionth of a beat, expressed as progress divided by the 32-note score length.
The performer changes only at released boundaries; hand/paw animation away from root transforms is not asserted to be globally smooth during the whole beat.
